name: Flappy Plane
author: Axe54
description: This game is a local 2-player airplane game. Much like Flappy Bird, the airplane can only travel vertically while overcoming obstacles (i.e. walls). The player (s) can toggle viewpoints from the pilot's seat or from a 3rd person standpoint. Player 1 controls: W (tilt plane down), S (tilt plane up), F (toggle view point). Player 2 controls: Up Key (tilt plane down), Down (tilt plane up), K (toggle view point).
